clue.text: Weapon held here, as one crossing the writers' picket line?

parts.note: a scab is a strike-breaker, someone who crosses a picket line
a bard is a poet, a writer of verse

explanation.surface: A question about a strike-breaking author crossing a picket line of fellow writers.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the second half as a SCAB BARD: a writer who crosses the writers' own picket line.
explanation.definitionFit: A scabbard is the sheath in which a sword is kept, so a weapon is held there.

clue.text: Very old concept, peaceful

parts.note: so means very
a thing can mean an idea or concept

explanation.surface: An ancient idea of calm.
explanation.definitionFit: Soothing means calming, bringing peace.

clue.text: A voyage taken up in another name

indicators.note: in a down clue, taking up reads the word from bottom to top

parts.note: a sail is a voyage by boat

explanation.surface: A sea voyage taken under a false identity.
explanation.definitionFit: An alias is an assumed or alternative name.

clue.text: Carter dressed warmly, head for Cumbrian town

parts.note: a barrow carts things, so it is a carter
wearing fur, in fur
a ness is a headland

explanation.surface: A carter wrapped up warmly heads off to a town in the north-west.
explanation.walkthrough: Cumbria is a county in north-west England. 'head' looks like a verb, but it is the headland, NESS.
explanation.definitionFit: Barrow-in-Furness is a port town in the county of Cumbria.

clue.text: Spare book

definitions.meaning: extra, kept back for use when needed
to book a table is to arrange it in advance

explanation.surface: A spare copy of a book.
explanation.definitionFit: Reserve means a spare (noun) and to book (verb) in advance.

clue.text: Horse given another drink

definitions.meaning: a steeplechaser, a horse that races over fences
a drink taken straight after another, such as beer after a spirit

explanation.surface: A racehorse is rewarded with a second round at the bar.
explanation.definitionFit: A chaser is both a jumps racehorse and a drink that follows another one.

clue.text: Appear in control having been given the best deal?

definitions.meaning: to have every advantage in a situation

definitions.text: having been given the best deal?
definitions.meaning: at cards, being dealt every winning card

explanation.surface: Seeming to be in charge after being handed the most favourable terms.
explanation.definitionFit: To hold all the cards is an idiom for having total control, and literally to be dealt the winners.

clue.text: Laugh about these people's cooking ingredient

indicators.note: the first word goes round the second

parts.note: a scream is a hilarious thing, something that is a laugh
our means belonging to us, these people

explanation.surface: Laughing about something used in these people's cooking.
explanation.definitionFit: Sour cream is soured dairy cream used in cookery.

clue.text: Unpleasant type beat palm

parts.note: a rat is a nasty, untrustworthy person
to tan someone's hide is to beat them

explanation.surface: A nasty character slaps someone's hand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'palm' looks like part of the hand; it is the plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Rattan is a climbing palm whose stems are used for cane furniture.

clue.text: One smiling as ball flying past ear?

definitions.meaning: in cricket, a delivery that reaches the batsman at head height without bouncing

explanation.surface: A batter grins as a ball whistles past the head.
explanation.walkthrough: Cricket: a bowler's full toss aimed at head height is a dangerous and illegal ball.
explanation.definitionFit: A beamer is both a person who beams and a cricket ball bowled at the head.

clue.text: Tree blossoming more, the first to be removed

indicators.note: tells us to drop the opening letter of the word just supplied

parts.note: rosier means pinker, more blooming

explanation.surface: A tree flowering more freely than ever, but its first bloom is taken off.
explanation.definitionFit: The osier is a type of willow tree grown for basket-making twigs.

clue.text: Outfit providing bomb action

parts.note: a shell is an explosive projectile, a kind of bomb
a suit is a legal action brought in court

explanation.surface: Some clothing that delivers explosive effect.
explanation.definitionFit: A shell suit is a lightweight tracksuit, a casual outfit popular in the 1980s.

clue.text: Representation blocked, as might soar out of control

indicators.note: letters running wild are rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A picture is obstructed, much as a runaway aircraft might soar unchecked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Representation blocked' means a picture made of blocks, not one that has been obstructed.
explanation.definitionFit: A histogram is a chart that represents data as blocks or bars.

clue.text: Line on graph accountant reversed, showing capital

indicators.note: the two pieces together are read from right to left

parts.note: an arc is a curved line that may be drawn on a graph
CA stands for chartered accountant

explanation.surface: An accountant's graph line turns back, revealing money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reversed' turns ARC + CA into ACCRA. 'capital' looks like money but is a capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: Accra is the capital city of Ghana.

clue.text: Ceremony observed, passing the fool salt

indicators.note: the ceremony goes past and follows on after the fool

parts.note: nit is British slang for a fool, short for nitwit
a rite is a ceremony

explanation.surface: At a formal ritual, someone hands the salt cellar to the idiot at table.
explanation.walkthrough: 'passing' looks like handing something over at table; here the ceremony comes after the fool.
explanation.definitionFit: A nitrite is a chemical salt of nitrous acid.

clue.text: Put on diet, elves given makeover

indicators.note: letters made over take a new form, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Elves put on a diet and transformed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put on' sounds like weight gained; it means broadcast.
explanation.definitionFit: Something put on air has been broadcast, shown on television.

clue.text: Wave that flattens lawn

definitions.meaning: a long heavy wave rolling onto a shore
a garden tool, a heavy cylinder pulled over grass to level it

explanation.surface: A wave like the machine that levels a lawn.
explanation.definitionFit: A roller is both a great breaking sea wave and a cylinder for flattening grass.

clue.text: Worker has part that's large

parts.note: a hand is a worker on a farm or ship
some means a part or portion

explanation.surface: A worker gets a large share.
explanation.definitionFit: A handsome sum is a large amount.

clue.text: Are cuddly toys so sentimental?

parts.note: soft toys are furry and downy, and a soppy, lightweight sentiment is described by the same word

explanation.surface: A question about whether soft toys are mawkish.
explanation.definitionFit: Fluffy describes a soft, downy toy and also sentiment that is light and woolly.

clue.text: Annual say finally produced before deadline?

indicators.note: the final letter of the word before it is taken

parts.note: early means ahead of the cut-off time

explanation.surface: A yearly report finished before the deadline.
explanation.definitionFit: Yearly means happening once a year, annual.

clue.text: I'm back to tuck into tea in old kingdom

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other, like food tucked inside

parts.note: bohea is a kind of black China tea

indicators.note: the word is read from right to left

parts.note: I'm gives the letters I and M

explanation.surface: Someone returning to eat their tea in an ancient realm.
explanation.walkthrough: Bohea is a black China tea, little known outside crosswords. 'tuck into' looks like eating, but signals one piece going inside another.
explanation.definitionFit: Bohemia was a historic kingdom, now the western part of the Czech Republic.

clue.text: Carrier for weapon, smooth, getting loaded shortly

parts.note: bald means hairless, smooth

indicators.note: cut short, so the final letter is dropped

parts.note: loaded is slang for rich

explanation.surface: A sleek holster with a gun loaded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shortly' cuts the H from RICH to leave RIC.
explanation.definitionFit: A baldric is a belt worn over the shoulder to carry a sword.

clue.text: Hawk's heading across the sky so remain there?

indicators.note: the head or opening letter of the word before it is taken

parts.note: over means above, going across the sky overhead

explanation.surface: A hawk flies over the sky and stays put.
explanation.definitionFit: To hover is to stay in one place in the air, as a kestrel does.

clue.text: Little boy found to be set aside

parts.note: Al is a short form of a boy's name such as Alan or Albert
located means found

explanation.surface: A small lad discovered to be put to one side.
explanation.definitionFit: Allocated means earmarked or set apart for a particular purpose.

clue.text: Dynasty requires a skimpy garment

parts.note: the Tang dynasty ruled China from 618 to 907

explanation.surface: A ruling family insists on a skimpy garment.
explanation.definitionFit: A tanga is a brief bikini bottom or thong.

clue.text: Leave witch, perhaps, to become religious type

parts.note: go means leave
a witch casts spells, so she might be called a speller

explanation.surface: Abandon witchcraft and become a devout person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' says the witch is just one example of someone who casts spells.
explanation.definitionFit: A gospeller is an evangelist or zealous preacher of the gospel.

clue.text: Piece written in letter on doormat

indicators.note: the answer lies written inside the following words

explanation.surface: A note left inside a letter on the mat.
explanation.definitionFit: A rondo is a musical piece with a recurring main theme.

clue.text: Head maintaining daughter is exhibitionist

indicators.note: the outer word holds the others within it

parts.note: nut is slang for the head

explanation.surface: A school head supports a daughter who is a show-off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exhibitionist' is literal here: someone who shows everything.
explanation.definitionFit: A nudist exhibits their body, so is literally an exhibitionist.

clue.text: Curry required more than one to decorate fish

parts.note: to ice is to decorate a cake with icing
skate is a flat fish

explanation.surface: A cook needed several fish for a curry garnish.
explanation.walkthrough: Curry is John Curry, the British Olympic champion figure skater, not food.
explanation.definitionFit: A figure skater like Curry needs a pair of boots with blades, each one an ice-skate.
